title: Day and Trial Passes: purchase pricing, discount selection, visit grant, and validity window at purchase
content:
This document states the basis on which a Day and Trial Passes purchase (Single Day Pass, Three-Day Trial Pass, Seven-Day Trial Pass, Weekly Visitor Pass, Monthly Trial Pass, Corporate Guest Pass) is priced, granted visits, and given a validity window, at the moment the purchase is activated.

## Rule
At purchase, the pass is priced at the tier's list price, less whichever single discount is higher between the guest-of-member discount (where a current member sponsors the purchase, and, where that tier's basis requires the sponsoring member's presence, that member checks in at the same visit) and the group purchase discount (where at least the tier's group purchase minimum quantity of passes of that same tier are purchased in the same transaction); the two discounts are never both applied, only the higher of the two that the purchase qualifies for. The pass grants the tier's included number of visits, or unlimited use within the tier's validity window where the tier's visits-included value denotes unlimited. The pass's last usable date is set to its first usable date plus the tier's validity-days count of calendar days.

### Points of judgement
- Where a purchase qualifies for both the guest-of-member discount and the group purchase discount at once, only the higher-rate one of the two is applied to the list price; the two are never added together or applied one after the other.
- Where a purchase qualifies for neither, the pass is priced at the tier's plain list price.
- The visits granted and the validity window are fixed by the tier chosen and do not vary with which discount, if any, applies to the price.
